reasons: Cited text supports the compliant claim: p0145 selects the internal laws of the State of New York and p0146 requires suit in the City of New York with irrevocable submission to the exclusive jurisdiction of the SDNY or New York state courts, matching GOVLAW's preferred position.
No arbitration seat or foreign forum appears in the cited clause, so there is nothing to flag under the walk-away trigger.

Appropriately no redline and no counterparty comment for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs and the deterministic check confirms the jurisdiction is within the accepted set.
